age: Here, we provide proteomic data of whole-tissue lysates (WTL) and low-solubility protein-enriched fractions (LSF) of major tissues collected from mice of 6, 15, 24, and 30 months of age.
developmental_stage: Based on our in-depth proteomic data and sample-matched transcriptome data of adult, middle-aged, old, and geriatric mice, we construct the Mouse aging proteomic atlas (https://aging-proteomics.info/), which provides a thorough and integrative view of age-related gene expression changes.
